answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Each submission hangs on the onyx of a task receipt, and the haven is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the voyage of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
